title: Sends are logged with message, recipient and time (no audit screen)
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in, on the build under test, as a service advisor with the view customers and create and edit customers permissions.
  2. Open Customers from the top navigation and switch to its "Maintenance reminders" tab.
  3. A worklist row whose customer has the setting "Maintenance notifications" on, a preferred contact on the asset, and a contact with an email address.
  4. Give the test customer's contact an email address you can open (e.g. your own work email), so the reminder lands in your inbox.
custom_steps:
1. Send a reminder from the row's Contact card.
  2. Read the card afterwards.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The card shows "Last sent" with today's date.
  • That the send was logged with its message, recipient and timestamp cannot be checked by hand in v1 — no screen shows the audit; it is for a developer or automated check. Pass or fail on what you can see, and write "audit not checked by hand" in the result comment.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780, story SV-10576 (S21, The audit trail), Chunk 1 MR (Confluence 886931488) as edited 5 October 2026, S21 (S21-R5, S21-N3); read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

  • S14-E2: “Sending a reminder writes an audit entry and updates last sent”
  • S21-R5: “Sends will be logged with message, recipient and timestamp”
